eligibility_reason: Original article proposing SFEDet (YOLO12-L based) trained and evaluated for bounding-box detection on NEU-DET.

F01.evidence: Each category contains 300 grayscale images, resulting in 1,800 images in total.
F01.location: Experimental setting > Dataset and evaluation protocol

F02.evidence: In our implementation, the development pool is further split into 1,296 training and 144 validation images; all quantitative results are reported on the independent test set.
F02.location: Experimental setting > Dataset and evaluation protocol

F03.value: test split defined by per-class image indices 241-300; how the 1,296/144 train/val split was drawn is not stated
F03.evidence: Following the standard NEU-DET partition protocol, images with indices 1–240 are used for model development, whereas images with indices 241–300 are reserved exclusively for testing
F03.location: Experimental setting > Dataset and evaluation protocol

F05.value: YOLO12-L backbone from official pretrained weights; new modules random init; baselines not described
F05.evidence: The YOLO12-L backbone is initialized from official pretrained weights, while newly introduced modules are randomly initialized.

F06.evidence: The model checkpoint with the highest validation mAP@0.5 is selected for test evaluation.

F07.evidence: Table 1 presents the detection performance on the NEU-DET test set.

F08.evidence: The best validation checkpoint is selected for test evaluation, which is performed using batch size 16 on the official test split.

F09.evidence: During training and inference, all images are resized to a fixed resolution of 640× 640.

F10.value: max 300 epochs, early stopping patience 50 (final model stopped at epoch 235)
F10.evidence: The maximum number of epochs is set to 300 with early stopping (patience of 50 epochs).

F11.evidence: the batch size is set to 4 during training

main_result.evidence: SFEDet (Large) achieves the highest mAP@0.5 of 75.1%, outperforming the baseline YOLO12-L (72.7%) by 2.4 points

coder_notes: Ultralytics link is the framework, not the authors' code. Internal inconsistencies: Table 2 first row (LGP only) shows 72.7 while text says LGP-only 72.6 and ablation protocol says YOLO12-L baseline is 72.7; text says YOLO26-L mAP 71.6 whereas Table 1 shows 69.6. Train/val split of development pool (1,296/144) method not described. Brightness robustness tables (Tables 3-4) are additional test-set evaluations.
